QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Unseen Enemy
QuestInfo.0: As you approach the third seal, the Primacy says they found the Flora army. Talk to the others and see if a change of plans is in order.
QuestInfo.1: As you approach the third seal, the Primacy says they found the Flora army. Talk to the others and see if a change of plans is in order.
QuestInfo.2: Enemy forces arrived while Iker and Hawkeye were arguing. It seems the Flora had been waiting for your party to split up. Thankfully, Iker and Hawkeye held off the enemies so you and Luce could go on ahead.
